# Rules for the dashboard (Next.js)

Before you change a file here, open the rules file for its part of the code, read
the contents list at its top, then read the entries your change touches. The rules
for every change are in the root `CLAUDE.md`.

| Code | Rules |
|---|---|
| `app/chat/`, `components/chat/` | `docs/rules/chat.md` |
| `app/terminals/`, `components/harness/`, `components/buildCode/`, `components/terminal/`, `components/folders/` | `docs/rules/build.md` |
| `components/settings/`, `app/settings/` | `docs/rules/settings.md` |
| `app/agents/`, `components/agents/`, `components/team/`, `components/sessions/`, `components/kanban/` | `docs/rules/agents.md` |
| `components/memory/`, `components/skills/`, `components/project/`, `components/projects/`, `components/help/` | `docs/rules/memory.md` |
| `components/connections/`, `components/tools/`, `components/accounts/`, `components/fleet/` | `docs/rules/connections.md` |
| `components/browser/` | `docs/rules/browser.md` |
| `components/workflow/`, `components/autonomy/`, the automation pages under `app/` | `docs/rules/automations.md` |
| `__tests__/`, `e2e/` | `docs/rules/ci.md` |
| everything else (`lib/`, shared `components/`, `app/layout.tsx`, `globals.css`) | `docs/rules/dashboard.md` |
